cases.name: module-lifespan-separated-from-constructor

files.src/main.py:
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app):
    resource = await open_resource()
    try:
        yield resource
    finally:
        await resource.close()
app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

cases.tradeoff: The common module-level lifespan form is conservatively missed because the current facts cannot bind the constructor argument back to the function component.
